name: Timestamped residual-state prediction under delayed sparse metrology
status: Exploratory follow-up on previously inspected public unseen splits; not a fresh blind test
fit: Original train only; retain exported feature order and base model
selection: Only original valid+test; all families selected independently on mean RMSE normalized by frozen error across delays 0,5,20 and phases 0,2 at fixed every-five requests. Select one configuration per dataset, never by unseen performance.

evaluation.primary: mean relative RMSE improvement over original GRAPE for delays 5 and 20 across both datasets and all phases >=10%, no dataset-delay mean regression >2%, P90 regression <=5%
evaluation.simple_baseline_gate: mean improvement vs strongest dev-selected EMA/RLS family >=5%, with both datasets non-worse at delay5 and20
evaluation.uncertainty: 5000 paired moving-block bootstrap, length50, shared sampled time blocks across phases; no independent-seed claims
evaluation.causality: Labels unavailable until requested and timestamp+delay reached. Own prediction always precedes own label. All methods have identical query schedule. No future covariates supplied to models.
evaluation.limits: Sample delay is an imposed stress test, not measured manufacturing wall time; no manufacturing cost/safety/novelty claim.
